retraction.reason: A15(8): the item’s English sitelink "Eritrean Civil Wars" redirects to "Eritrean War of Independence" (Q607257), a different item this atlas already holds as its own record, and that article names the Eritrean Civil Wars only in its See also list - no section is about them. So there is no article and no section to read a span from, the quoted summary was the War of Independence’s lead and not this record’s, and the record carries no edge to anything. Retracted under §1: a record that cannot earn an edge is retracted with its reason.
